answer: A working identity is admitted only after a 14-day exclusive key ceremony and an 800-unit bond. The first seat from a funding cluster costs that 800; each extra seat from the same deposit trail pays n-squared times 800, slashed if later clustering is proven. An honest operator locks 800 once and earns along the ordinary ridge of work. At the zenith of a farm, fifty sock puppets from one trail would immobilize 50 squared times 800, or 2,000,000 units — a ferrous mass no cloned profile can shrink.
